description.value: La Pache Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain serving authentic Neapolitan-style pies with fresh dough made from scratch daily at their Commercial Drive location. The menu spans meat, vegetable, and vegan options, with online ordering available. Commercial Drive is one of Vancouver's most-used cycling corridors, placing this spot directly on route for cyclists crossing through East Vancouver.
